11... 12... Mmm... good. I think I'll be able to finish before tonight's party. Oh! I didn't notice you were here!
scripts.translation:
{0}
11... 12... 嗯... 不错。我想今晚的派对前能完工。哦！没注意到你来了！

scripts.text:
{0}
How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
{0}
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: - Talk
scripts.translation: - 交谈

scripts.text: - Dye Clothing
scripts.translation: - 服装染色

scripts.text: - Price List
scripts.translation: - 价格表

scripts.text:
{0}
For us humans, who have no colorful fur or decorative scales, clothes are one of the few ways we have to display our personality, style, and beauty.
scripts.translation:
{0}
人类没有艳丽的皮毛，也没有漂亮的鳞片，衣服便成了展现个性、风格和美丽的少数方式之一。

scripts.text:
{0}
Haha... When I think about it, I really feel that my job is worthwhile.  I believe that I provide a service that the people desire.

{0}
Can you feel it too? The energy that is released when rough fabric and leather are brought to life with color?.....
scripts.translation:
{0}
你也感受得到吗？粗糙的布料和皮革经过染色，焕发出生命力时的那股活力...

scripts.text:
{0}
Although the process is very tedious and time consuming, the joy and happiness I feel when a dress is finished more than makes up for all of the hard work!!
scripts.translation:
{0}
虽然过程非常繁琐且耗时，但当一件衣服完工时，我感到的喜悦和幸福足以弥补所有的辛苦！！

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh... you need my work? Well... okay, sounds good.
scripts.translation:
{0}
哦...需要我帮忙？嗯...好，没问题。

scripts.text:
{0}
Sorry, I'm too busy with other jobs to dye your clothes.
scripts.translation:
{0}
抱歉，我手头有其他工作，没时间为你的衣服染色。

{0}
请选择适合你的颜色。

scripts.text: Wow, I've never seen clothes like that before! I'm sorry, but I don't think I can paint it.
scripts.translation:
哇，我从没见过这样的衣服！
抱歉，恐怕没办法给它染色。
